decisions.reason: The rye country bread remains a solid fit with the bakery’s everyday core range, though the firm may still trim overlapping bread variants if shelf space and production capacity are needed elsewhere.
The rye mixed bread with seeds matches continuing demand for hearty, slightly health-oriented breads and stays close to the firm’s artisanal strengths.

The dark barley malt rye bread is the most niche and internally overlapping of the rye launches, so dropping it would simplify the assortment and free resources for stronger staple lines or new development.
After the withdrawal of the premium raisin stollen, the marzipan Christmas stollen still gives the bakery a credible seasonal specialty for holiday and gift business.
The ancient grain bread fits the firm’s traditional, natural and craft-based positioning especially well and offers some differentiation without moving far from its established capabilities.
